1 compartment: Biota (Biota, Aquatic)

4 biota samples. Species (2): Mya arenaria, Astarte borealis. Tissue types: Total soft tissues. Life stages: Adult. Genders: Not reported

4 protocols:
Sampling Protocol - Grab: (Mussels were collected by means of a dredge fitted with a 5-mm mesh net. Then, mussels of size between 30-40 mm were selected and left for 24 hours in sea water for depuration. The uppermost 5-cm layer of sediments was collected by means of a Petterson grab sampler, and kept frozen until analysis.)
Fractionation Protocol - Not reported
Extraction Protocol - Acid digestion: (Total metals: Aliquots of 1.00 g of oven-dried (80°C, 16 h) and homogenized sediment samples were wet digested with a mixture of HClO4:HF (1:5) in teflon bombs at 140°C for 4 hr. Soft tissue of mussels was separated from the shells, lyophilized and homogenized. Successively, aliquots of 1.00 g were wet digested in glass vessels with 6 ml of HNO3 conc., followed by 4 ml of HClO4 conc.)
Extraction Protocol - Sequential extraction: (A 4-step extraction procedure adapted from Förstner and Wittmann was used: (a) 0.11 M acetic acid to isolate metals adsorbed to surfaces of sediment particles; (b) 0.05 M hydroxylamine hydrochloride for metals associated with manganese and iron hydroxides; (c) 1.0 M ammonium acetate after digestion with 5 ml of 8.8 M hydrogen peroxide for metals complexed with organic substances; (d) mixture of HF:HClO4 (5:1) for metals incorporated in crystal lattice of clay minerals.)
